title: WaitlistCommandsMatchV1
description: Queue-only trigger contract (spec 11 §5.1) crossing the broker to the waitlist consumer (consumer 'waitlist.processor'). Instructs the worker to offer a freed first-party opening to the next eligible enrollee: find the FIFO-first enrollee, reserve a temporary hold, and make a deadline-bound offer (auto-booking it when a recorded consent grant permits). Emitted on initial enrollment-driven matching and as a re-match after a decline/expiry. Carries NO secrets or PII beyond opaque ids (Inv-12).

message_type.description: Explicit schema discriminator; always 'waitlist.commands.match.v1' for this contract.

tenant_id.description: Tenant scope. All consumer-side writes are scoped to this tenant (Inv-13).

correlation_id.description: Correlation identifier propagated across the waitlist chain (typically the freed slot id).

causation_id.description: message_id of the direct cause (nullable for synthetic/system-generated triggers).

location_id.description: Location of the matched opening; part of the enrollee-eligibility criteria.

service_id.description: Service of the matched opening; part of the enrollee-eligibility criteria.

slot_id.description: First-party slot of the freed opening; re-reserved against a temporary hold when offered.

slot_start.description: Start time of the matched slot; checked against the enrollee's acceptable window and carried into the offer.

available_seats.description: Seats available in the matched opening; bounds the enrollee party size that can be offered.
